name: Yamaha DT1 / DT250
engine: 246 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection
intro: The bike that started the Japanese enduro boom. The Autolube pump is the part to get right.

add.title: Check the Autolube pump
add.instructions: Rebuild the pump with fresh seals, bleed it and check its output against the manual. Use the right pump for your model.
add.reason: A pump that underfeeds oil will seize the engine. Pumps from other models deliver different amounts.

H: Some owners run a lean premix as well as the pump, as a safety net.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Pump swaps
known.what: Oil pumps that look the same deliver different amounts. A 125 pump won't work for a 250.
